name: Chime of Opening
description: A slim silver tube that rings like struck glass.
body:
## What it does

Strike it as an action, pointing it at something within 120 feet that can be opened, a door, a lid or a lock. If the sound can reach it, one lock or latch on it opens, and once none are left, the thing itself opens.

## Charges

It can be struck ten times, and then it cracks and is useless.

features.name: Opening
features.text: Spend a charge to open one lock or latch on an object within 120 feet, or the object itself once none are left.
